Name: Interiors of Pelican Town - The Trailer - Pam and Penny
Author: QueenAcademe
Description:
[b]Description

[/b]The "Interiors of Pelican Town" suite of mods redesigns the homes and common spaces of Pelican Town. This installation redesigns Pam and Penny's trailer.

[b]Compatibility 
[/b]
To use with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url], open the SVE mod folder and navigate to [CP] Stardew Valley Expanded --> Code --> Locations --> MapPatches.json. Open using any text editor and remove:

   {
               "Action": "Load",  
               "Target": "Maps/Trailer",
               "FromFile": "Assets/maps/locations/Trailer.tbin"
          },
